What it adds, depending on what you build

POS platforms

Redemption happens at the till your merchants already use. No new hardware, no staff retraining, and Pass capability becomes a reason to stay on your system.

Loyalty and rewards

Members exchange points against live merchant supply instead of a fixed catalogue that never changes. Your redemption rates stop being a function of catalogue fatigue.

Payment gateways

Attach verified offers to transactions your merchants already process through you. A new line on the same rails.

How the partnership works

1

Connect once

REST or MCP, against a sandbox you get on signup. Certification before you go live in production.

2

Your merchants inherit the capability

One agreement covers the merchants on your platform. They do not each sign separately, and they do not each integrate.

3

You earn on every Pass sold

Revenue share settled at the point of sale rather than at redemption, so your earnings do not depend on whether a customer turns up at the counter.

Support stays where the relationship is. You keep the merchant relationship and the commercial terms with them. Mezzofy handles Pass validation, consumer support and settlement.

Questions partners ask

Who owns the merchant relationship?

You do. Your commercial terms with your merchants are yours. Mezzofy handles Pass validation, consumer support and settlement, and never contacts your merchants directly without your say-so.

Does each merchant sign with Mezzofy?

No. One partnership agreement covers the merchants on your platform. They opt in through your interface and inherit the terms.

How long is certification?

Typically two to three weeks from a working sandbox integration. We test issuance, redemption, failure handling and settlement reconciliation before production keys are issued.

Is the partnership exclusive?

Not by default. Exclusivity in a market or category is available against volume commitments and is priced accordingly.

What if a merchant on my platform refuses a valid Pass?

The customer is credited automatically, and the merchant is flagged. Repeated refusals suspend their listing. We will tell you before it reaches that point.

Start in the sandbox today.

No commercial commitment to begin building. Terms when you are ready to go live.
